description.en: The ID of the cloud disk that you want to release.
The region ID of the instance.

title.zh: 释放一块按量付费数据盘

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：
- 您的磁盘手动快照会被保留。
- 释放磁盘时，云盘的状态必须为待挂载（Available）。
- 如果指定ID的磁盘不存在，请求将被忽略。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, take note of the following items:

*   Manual snapshots of the disk are retained.
*   The disk must be in the Unattached (Available) state.
*   If no disk with the specified disk ID exists, the request will be ignored.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds delete-rc-disk --disk-id rcd-wz9c8isqly8637zw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
